article_title: OpenTelemetry Logging in .NET：从 ILogger 到结构化日志导出
core_theme: 在 .NET 中通过 OpenTelemetry SDK 将 ILogger 日志集成到可观测性管线，实现自动 trace 关联、结构化日志导出和与 traces/metrics 的统一后端查询
reader_takeaway: 学会从零配置 OpenTelemetry logging，理解 ILogger 集成原理、trace context 自动关联、OTLP 导出和生产环境最佳实践
summary_angle: 三信号汇聚：从 ILogger 日志出发 → 自动关联 traceId/spanId → 通过 OTLP exporter 统一导出到可观测后端，形成一个完整的可观测性日志闭环

information_blocks.source_anchor: How ILogger Integrates section — ILogger integrates at provider level via AddOpenTelemetry(), no code changes needed at call sites
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧 ILogger 调用点 → 中间的 OpenTelemetry Provider 作为桥梁 → 右侧结构化 LogRecord 流出

information_blocks.source_anchor: Automatic Trace Context Correlation section — Activity.Current provides traceId/spanId automatically, no extra code
information_blocks.visual_idea: 追踪跨度（span）和日志记录之间用虚线高亮连接，traceId/spanId 标签自动注入日志

information_blocks.source_anchor: Exporting with OTLP section — AddOtlpExporter() with BatchLogRecordExportProcessor for production
information_blocks.visual_idea: 批量日志记录汇聚成数据流，通过 OTLP 协议箭头指向远端的 Grafana/Seq/Azure Monitor 后端

main_metaphor: 信号流水线：ILogger 日志像原材料从左侧流入，经过 OpenTelemetry Provider 的加工站（自动注入 trace context），最后通过 OTLP 管道输送到右侧的可观测后端
primary_subject: 一条从左到右的信号处理流水线，ILogger 日志 → Provider 加工 → 结构化 LogRecord → OTLP 导出 → 后端可视化
subject_action: 日志信号在流水线上从左到右流动，经过标注的加工节点，最终汇聚到可观测后端

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration. Theme: OpenTelemetry Logging in .NET — integrating ILogger with OpenTelemetry SDK to export structured logs with automatic trace correlation. The reader should understand the complete logging pipeline from ILogger to observability backend.

Summary angle: Three-beat signal pipeline: ILogger logs flow in → OpenTelemetry Provider injects traceId/spanId automatically → OTLP exporter sends structured LogRecords to observability backends (Grafana, Seq, Azure Monitor).
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats.
Information blocks:
- Mechanism: Provider integration — ILogger calls flow through OpenTelemetry provider via AddOpenTelemetry(), no code changes needed; visual: ILogger call sites on left, Provider bridge in center, structured LogRecord flowing right; visible label: 「Provider」
- Mechanism: Auto correlation — Activity.Current provides traceId/spanId automatically injected into logs; visual: span and log record connected by highlighted dotted line with traceId/spanId tags; visible label: 「traceId」
- Step: OTLP export — AddOtlpExporter() with BatchLogRecordExportProcessor for production; visual: batched log records flowing through OTLP protocol arrow to backend icons; visible label: 「OTLP」

Main metaphor: Signal processing pipeline — raw ILogger logs flow in from left, pass through the OpenTelemetry Provider processing station (auto-injecting trace context), then flow through OTLP pipe to observability backends on the right.
Subject: A left-to-right signal processing pipeline: ILogger logs → Provider processing → structured LogRecord → OTLP export → backend visualization.
Composition/framing: Horizontal pipeline progression. Prefer horizontal storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: black-and-white printmaking look, carved textures, bold shadows, high contrast, poster-like but no title text. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: pure black and white, dark gray mid-tones, high contrast negative space.
Visible text policy: allow only 3 short labels (「ILogger」「Provider」「OTLP」). No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams with invented labels, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: fake terminal output, fake dashboards, fake architecture diagram node names, neon light pollution, multi-color palettes, poster title text.
